headline: Maresca fine with Foden red, says Bruno should have been sent off too
description: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca backed referee Michael Oliver's decision to send off Phil Foden in his team's 1-0 win against Manchester United, but said that Reds captain Bruno Fernandes should also have been shown a red card.

headline: Premier League recap: Haaland, Man City defeat United in derby
Contentious Erling Haaland goal decides Manchester derby in Man City's favor
